# Haylo
> Local digital marketing agency specialising in Google Business Profile management, local SEO, review generation, Facebook page management, and website creation for tradespeople and service businesses on the Sunshine Coast, Queensland, Australia. Founded by Sam Davies. All services are month-to-month with no lock-in contracts. Phone: 0490 422 192. Email: hello@withhaylo.com.

## Services
- Google Business Profile management - setup, optimisation, and ongoing management to get local businesses into the Google Maps top 3
- Local SEO - improving organic visibility in Google Search for Sunshine Coast suburbs including Caloundra, Maroochydore, Buderim, Noosa, Kawana, Nambour, and Glass House Mountains
- Review generation - strategy and implementation to grow Google review count and rating
- Facebook Business Page management - setup and ongoing management for service businesses
- Website creation and SEO - locally optimised websites for trades and service businesses
- Monthly performance reporting - plain-English reports covering profile views, phone clicks, and review stats

## Service areas
Sunshine Coast, Queensland, Australia - including Caloundra, Maroochydore, Buderim, Noosa, Kawana, Nambour, Glass House Mountains, Mooloolaba, and surrounding suburbs.

## Target audience
Tradespeople (plumbers, electricians, builders, painters, roofers, tilers, concreters, carpenters, fencers, handymen, plasterers, solar installers, air conditioning), cleaners, landscapers, pest control, pool services, health and wellness businesses, and other local service businesses on the Sunshine Coast.

## Pricing
- Visibility Foundation: $590 AUD one-time (full GBP optimisation)
- Growth Accelerator: $1,290 AUD one-time (GBP + website SEO + 60-day growth plan)
- Growth Partner: $650 AUD per month (ongoing management - no lock-in)
